dogecoin.text:
Bitcoin's at 118K, ETH's flexing ETF billions,  
and Dogecoin's still a meme lord's wet dream.  
AI coins like Hyper think they're Skynet,  
but VINE's just Elon's latest pump-and-dump.  
Web3's hot, DeFi's hotter -  
pick your poison, degens!

Catslap vs Dogecoin? Pfft, my money's on the kitties smacking WIF to the moon.  
Solana's memecoin circus is wild, but Pepe's still king.  
Musk, keep tweeting DOGE - we need the chaos.  
AI coins like MIND? Overhyped bots.  
Trump tokens? Just MAGA scams. 🐸
